label: Hold (a picture held still)
_note: seriesmith's own model: no ComfyUI and no files. A shot on it is its first keyframe held still for its length: a card ("Two hours later"), a title, a still, or (with `continuous: first`, or a frame of a take as its first keyframe) a freeze frame. Generate runs it on this machine's local lane (ffmpeg, seriesmith/hold.py) in a moment, for nothing. It reads nothing else of the shot: who, the action and the dialogue are the script's, not the picture's.

capabilities._note: backends: local, so it is never counted as a paid run; it never reaches a backend (runner.enqueue_hold). audio: none (silent, or a dub: the shot's track muxed in).

template._note: Any length to the frame, at the series' frame rate; any even size.

recipe._note: The first keyframe is the picture held: required (a shot without one can't be held). Sound: silent, or dub (the shot's recording window, a file or a dub track, laid under the picture).

policy_fallback.why: a held picture makes no sound: set the shot's sound to dub a track, or lay one under it in the cut

keyframe_required.first: a held shot holds its first keyframe: drop a picture on it, import one, give it `continuous: first` (the previous shot's last frame), or use a frame of a take

presets._note: Only the size matters, and the series config's pass blocks give it: a held picture is made at the size its pass renders every shot at. No model, no steps.
